hypotheses.reasoning: account-svc v2.5.0 was rolled out at 02:27:57 (replacing v2.4.5, ready at 02:28:29). From 02:29:56 onward, POST /login fails with TypeError reading 'tier' at user-formatter.ts:78 in format(), tagged [v2.5.0]. The errors recur for different users (u-5047, u-5075, u-5077). Each surfaces as a 500 at edge-proxy (#1277, #1511, #1756, #1795) as the upstream account-svc 500. Those edge 500s are downstream symptoms, not the cause. The timing matches the deploy, and no equivalent errors appear before it. The billing invoice_archive checksum errors (#515 etc.) are in a separate service with no link to the login path, so I treat them as a red herring.

Billing-reconciler reports invoice_archive rows violating checksum constraints across 2019 partitions. This is a real data-integrity problem, but it is isolated to the billing archive and does not appear in the login path. It is unlikely to be the cause of the POST /login 500s.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back account-svc v2.5.0 to v2.4.5 immediately to restore POST /login. Then patch user-formatter.ts:78 to guard against undefined user/tier values, add a test for that case, and redeploy. Track the invoice_archive checksum violations separately.
